'''''Castle Bocce''''' was a restored [[Pre-Settlement era]] resort and [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with Gamma-class cuisine and accommodations. Its features included ten multi-species [[swimming pool]]s and nightly [[Karuki dance]] shows. [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]] customers on the [[Grand Galactic Tour]] were provided accommodations at ''Castle Bocce'' while visiting Tatooine.<ref name="TRG1-110" />
